notes: AgentSkill deploys with explicit launch ownership and two-step ownership transfer. It uses the fixed Ethereum ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry at 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 and ReputationRegistry at 0x8004BAa17C55a88189AE136b182e5fdA19dE9b63. Registered identity owners manage skills and endorse other agents, with self-endorsement and duplicate identity or wallet endorsements rejected. Scores weight live reputation at 60%, historical evidence at 25%, and skill endorsements at 15%. Historical evidence defaults to reputation quality scaled by feedback count; feedback records are not accepted jobs. The owner can configure an external work-history adapter for finalized and accepted work; no adapter implementation is included or deployed. Rankings revert until the owner configures a nonempty trusted feedback publisher set; the constructor leaves this set empty. The default reputation metric filter is empty (the registry's match-all filter) with no secondary tag, so no publisher record is silently dropped; the owner can narrow the metric tags, change the publishers, set the per-read source gas budget (default 5,000,000 gas, bounded 1,000,000 to 10,000,000), and configure or clear the optional work source. This manifest supplies no initialization calls. Global top-agent results require merging ranking pages at the same block. No token, pool, ETH funding, or additional application contract is deployed.
